content: The river that flows in you also flows in me. Look within: you will see the light shining in every breath.
author: Kabir
explanation: Beneath diverse physical forms and social personas, one unbroken stream of vitality and consciousness animates every living being without hierarchy.
practicalInsight: Look into the eyes of a stranger, colleague, or family member today and deliberately recognize the identical life-force animating them.
reflectionPrompt: How would my daily reactions transform if I truly saw the same stream flowing in everyone I meet?
originalQuote: The river that flows in you also flows in me. Look within: you will see the light shining in every breath.
